summary: I changed nothing: scripts/e2e.mjs already held the landing part, so I only ran it. The landing part passed twice in a row on fresh servers, and the full run then passed once. Nothing is broken and no servers are left running. The ground is not invisible as the brief says; it is already drawn as a flat tan plane (details under behaviour).
done: Read scripts/e2e.mjs in full. It has landing(), PRIMACY2_LANDING_ONLY=1, installLandingTools(), frameRates() and the screenshots. The tree was clean, so the script was already committed by the checkpoint job.
Item 8 is already done: foldHops pushes 'the fold tunnel to X was never seen' into problems, which fails the run. Neither full-run log contains the word tunnel or warning.

Landing-only run 1 (fresh build, .data deleted): e2e ok. Last lines: 'lander: ok: undocked 750 m from the pad centre', 'frame rate during the descent ... minimum 60.0 fps over a second, median 59.9 fps', 'e2e ok'.
Landing-only run 2 (.data deleted again): e2e ok, with the same lines and the same numbers.
Full node scripts/e2e.mjs (.data deleted): exit 0, last line 'e2e ok'. The fight steps did not flake and no rerun was needed.
Opened screenshots 43-landed-cockpit, 44-landed-chase and 48-docked-at-base with the Read tool (after the full run, so they come from that run).
notDone: Did not edit anything, as nothing needed fixing.
Did not test PRIMACY2_LANDING_REMOTE=1, the search for a base in another system. In the fixed universe the base is in the home system, so that branch never ran.
Did not open the other screenshots (40 to 42, 45 to 47, 49 to 52). I did not judge how the ground looks from the numbered landing shots beyond the three named.

Did not investigate the crasher's 'last seen' sample after the 70 m/s dive. It shows height 0.9 to 1.9 m and vertical speed +14 to +16 m/s, not a downward rate. The check that the crasher fell at more than 40 m/s still passes because it uses the recorded fastest descent. Either the ship bounced before it was destroyed, or the last sample is stale. I did not reproduce the case to tell which.
Did not test lifting off with another ship standing nearby, or any ground case other than the one pad.
verification:
Commands: npm run build, rm -rf .data, then PRIMACY2_LANDING_ONLY=1 node scripts/e2e.mjs, twice, with .data deleted before each run. Then rm -rf .data and node scripts/e2e.mjs. Port 8420 held only a TIME_WAIT socket before the second run. After the last run nothing was listening on 8420 or 8421, and git status was clean. Logs are in the scratchpad: land1.log, land2.log, full1.log. I did not rerun tsc or vitest, because I touched no code.

Numbers from the logs, all runs agreeing:
- Drop: cruise ends at about 6,995 m height, at 104 to 106 m/s vertical, with the notice 'Cruise ended: below the cruise ceiling.'
- Landing: mode 5, landed true, hull 220 of 220, height 0, speed 0, 349 to 352 m from the pad centre.
- Thirty seconds on the ground: the ship moved 0.0 m.
- Hard landing at 18.3 to 18.4 m/s: the hull lost 31.8 to 33.8 percent (220 to about 146 to 150). The rule says 34.3 percent.
- 70 m/s dive: destroyed, notice 'Crashed into the ground.' The wreck is listed 12 to 13 m from where the crasher last was.
- Lift-off to 5.7 to 5.8 m, 'Press F to dock' at the pad, the dock command accepted, the market lists 10 goods, undock about 750 m from the pad centre.
- Frame rate during the 179 s descent, with a second pilot rendering at the same time: minimum 60.0 fps over a second, median 59.9 fps. That is above 30, so there is no frame-rate finding.

Screenshots opened with the Read tool:
- 43-landed-cockpit: top left shows Hellear, Secure, Alpha Reach, 2,500 CR, CARGO 0/16 t. Top right shows NAV, Ezis Ground, 352 m, with a diamond marker and label on the left edge. Bottom left shows the SHD, HULL, PWR, HEAT and FUEL bars and the SYS, ENG and WEP pips. Bottom centre shows '0 m/s' with a LANDED tab and an ASSIST tab, 'Press Space to lift off' and 'Press F to dock'. 'Click to take the controls' is overlaid, as the headless run has no pointer lock. The footer reads 'Space lift off · F dock at a base · M map...'. The cockpit frame and cyan light strips are drawn.
- 44-landed-chase: the same HUD, now showing 323 m to the base. The Wisp ship model is seen from behind, standing on the ground.
- 48-docked-at-base: panel 'EZIS GROUND, Ground base on Hellear IV a, Controlled by House Zeregyk', with a 2,500 CR balance and a Launch button. Tabs are Market, Services, Outfitting and Missions. It shows the Import licence gauge (2,000 TU free) and the commodity table (Iron Ore, Copper Ore, Titanium Ore, Platinum Ore, Silicates, Machinery, Food, Water, Medicine and more) with Buy and Sell buttons and quantity boxes.", "behaviour": "What the screenshots show against the brief:
- The ground is already drawn. Below a flat horizon line there is a uniform dark olive-tan surface, with faint soft blotches in the chase view. That is a flat plane or a placeholder, not terrain. It sits behind the docked panel too.
- The base has no model. At 350 m from the pad, only the nav marker and a distance label show it.
- The HUD already shows LANDED and the lift-off and dock prompts, but still has no height, vertical speed or slope readout. The speed gauge reads '0 m/s' and nothing else.
- Nothing misbehaved, but both items above differ from the brief, so tell whoever builds the terrain renderer.

The script's rules, with numbers:
- Both pilots fly together: undock, cruise to the base, then drop at the ceiling about 7 km above the ground.
- The lander descends to 350 m beside the pad.
- The crasher takes a hard landing at 18 m/s down, which must damage the hull by 0.5 to 1.6 times the rule's share.
- The crasher then dives at 70 m/s and must be destroyed.
- Both landing checks are asserted: landed state and no hull damage, and no movement in 30 s.
- The lander lifts off, flies to the pad and docks.
- The frame rate over one-second windows is a finding only below 30."
names: PRIMACY2_LANDING_ONLY=1: plays only the landing part (landing() in scripts/e2e.mjs).
PRIMACY2_LANDING_REMOTE=1: forces the search for a base in another system. Not exercised.
PRIMACY2_JOURNEY_ONLY=1: plays only the cross-server journey.
PRIMACY2_DEBUG=1: adds the controller's debug fields to the descent progress lines.

Screenshots 40 to 52 in screenshots/e2e/. 40, 40b, 41, 41b, 42 to 49 are the lander and its approach. 50 to 51 are the hard-landing and crash shots of the second pilot. 52 is the wreck seen from the lander.
window.__L (injected into the page): the test's steering controller. It also records vertical and ground speed before an impact and the frame times.
requests: Owner: the landing part is already in the script and passes, so no further work is needed from me unless you want the PRIMACY2_LANDING_REMOTE=1 branch tried or a check added for the drawn ground.

Whoever builds the terrain renderer: the flat tan ground plane and the missing base model are what the first screenshots show. 43-landed-cockpit, 44-landed-chase and 48-docked-at-base are the baseline to compare against.

Owner or core engineer: the last sample before a 70 m/s dive ends the ship shows a small upward speed at about 1 m height. Check whether the ship bounces before it is destroyed, or the HUD number lags.
